title: MonitorEO
description:
MonitorEO-OBSNEV is an open monitoring tool of Essential Biodiversity Variables based on satellite sensors and models generated by the University of Granada. It enables citizens, managers, and scientists to create maps and graphs of key ecosystem metrics to support decision-making.

MonitorEO is an output of the EVEREST Project (PID2023-151939OB-I00), funded by MICIU/AEI 10.13039/501100011033, and co-funded by ERDF – European Union, as well as of the NevadEO Project (C-EXP-074-UGR23), co-funded by the ERDF 2014-2020 Program and the Regional Ministry of Economy, Knowledge, Enterprise, and Universities of the Regional Government of Andalusia. It is also an output of the PRESINMED Project (Preserving the singularity of Mediterranean high-mountain biodiversity hotspots: a NBS approach, PCI 2025-163175) of the Biodiversa+ NBS 2023 call.

MonitorEO computes with Google Earth Engine (Gorelick et al., 2017). The references are those of the formulas and algorithms of its variables, of the Earth Engine datasets that it uses (cited as their pages of the Earth Engine catalog suggest) and of its methods; each result of MonitorEO lists its own.
